mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.supplier_return_id AS supplierReturnId, sr.supplier_return_code AS supplierReturnCode, sr.warehouse_node_id AS warehouseNodeId, wn.node_name AS warehouseNodeName, sr.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.supplier_name AS supplierName, sr.return_status AS returnStatus, sr.return_type AS returnType, sr.apply_user_id AS applyUserId, sr.apply_time AS applyTime, sr.audit_user_id AS auditUserId, sr.audit_time AS auditTime, sr.audit_opinion AS auditOpinion, sr.remark, sr.create_time AS createTime FROM spd_supplier_return sr LEFT JOIN spd_org_node wn ON sr.warehouse_node_id = wn.node_id AND wn.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN spd_supplier s ON sr.supplier_id = s.supplier_id AND s.del_flag = 0 WHERE sr.del_flag = 0 AND sr.supplier_return_id = #{supplierReturnId}
